newsitem.title: USA: Prudential in outsourcing pact with IBM.
newsitem.headline: Prudential in outsourcing pact with IBM.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America and IBM Global Services, a unit of International Business Machines Corp, said Thursday they signed a five-year, $200 million information technology services agreement.
The pact expands on an outsourcing contract signed last September for Prudential's individual insurance and money management groups.
Prudential said the new deal would focus on applications maintenance and enhancement services for Prudential HealthCare, the company's health care business.
The agreement also provides for IBM Global Services to offer jobs to about 300 Prudential employees, the companies said.
Prudential HealthCare operates health care plans that serve about 4.7 million members.
